london: Your traveler asked about a city where fog is a lifestyle and umbrellas are practically part of the dress code.
They wanted to know if the place with double-decker buses still drives on what they called ‘the wrong side of history’.
They mentioned a river crossed by too many postcards and guards who refuse to smile on principle.
paris: They kept asking about a city that worships butter, baguettes, and an iron tower everyone mistakes for romance.
They said they preferred places where the word ‘bonjour’ can mean hello, goodbye, and ‘I’m judging your outfit’.
They mentioned a city of narrow streets, long lunches, and strikes so regular you could set your watch by them.
berlin: Your suspect asked whether the city that once argued with a wall still sells pieces of it to tourists.
They said they were heading somewhere with serious museums by day and questionable techno by night.
They wanted to know if the gate named after a novelist’s favorite brand of toothpaste still attracts crowds. I assume they meant the famous one.
new_york_city: They wondered if the place with yellow taxis, impatient horns, and towering glass ego monuments ever actually sleeps.
They asked whether the city with a torch-bearing statue welcomes more tourists or more bad decisions.
They mentioned a skyline so crowded with skyscrapers that even the pigeons need career plans.
warsaw: Your client was curious about a capital guarded by a mermaid and a river that has seen more history than most textbooks.
They asked if the city with a royal castle on a hill still argues about which pierogi are the ‘real’ ones.
They mentioned a place where old stone, new glass, and stubborn optimism all share the same tram lines.
new_delhi: They wanted to know about a capital where traffic negotiates directly with fate and horns are a form of small talk.
They said they were craving a city of chai, crowded bazaars, and colors bright enough to wake the guilty and the jet-lagged.
They asked if it’s true that in this place, even the air smells like spices, stories, and slightly burned secrets.
